val [prefixPaddingMs](prefix-padding-ms.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)?

Duration of detected speech required before start-of-speech is committed. Lower values detect shorter utterances but yield more false positives.
